categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: Internet marketing services, fine chemical products manufacturing (including forest chemical products), and ink chemical products manufacturing. The Internet marketing segment includes performance marketing and brand marketing services, serving industries such as gaming, automotive, finance, education, and real estate. The fine chemical segment focuses on turpentine, rosin deep processing, and other forest chemical products used in detergents, disinfectants, fragrances, tires, and pharmaceuticals. The ink chemical segment produces environmentally friendly inks including water-based and solvent-based inks, serving packaging printing for food, daily necessities, and pharmaceuticals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital marketing technologies including AI-generated content (AIGC) platforms, big data analytics, and automated media buying systems. In chemical production, it employs advanced synthesis and distillation techniques for turpentine and rosin derivatives, uses automated production equipment from global suppliers for ink manufacturing, and develops proprietary resin synthesis platforms. The company emphasizes green and sustainable production methods, including development of biodegradable inks and low-VOC emulsions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known brands in gaming, automotive, finance, education, real estate, fast-moving consumer goods, and e-commerce sectors. The Internet marketing services cater to both large key accounts and thousands of small to medium clients. The chemical products serve packaging printing enterprises, pharmaceutical intermediates, and industrial applications domestically and internationally. The company also targets overseas markets in Europe, America, Japan, Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Guangdong, Hangzhou, Chengdu, and other regions. It has marketing and service networks in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shanxi, Hangzhou, and Nanjing. Overseas sales focus on Southeast Asia (Malaysia, Thailand, Myanmar), Europe, America, Japan, and the Middle East. The company plans to expand overseas presence by establishing branches or marketing offices.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures fine chemical intermediates and inks (midstream) and provides integrated digital marketing services (downstream) to end customers. It also controls upstream raw material supply through strategic partnerships with resin and turpentine suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening digital transformation and AI integration in marketing services, expanding overseas markets, and innovating green chemical products. R&D focuses on AIGC platforms for automated content creation, new chemical synthesis processes, environmentally friendly inks, and product upgrades such as degradable inks and functional coatings. The company invests in big data platforms, intelligent marketing tools, and industrial digitalization platforms to enhance operational efficiency and customer service.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees from Internet marketing campaigns (performance-based and brand marketing), product sales of fine chemical and ink products, and licensing or technology services. The Internet marketing segment earns income based on actual ad consumption (clicks, impressions) and contract-based service fees. Chemical segments generate revenue from direct sales, including domestic and export transactions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading integrated digital marketing and fine chemical manufacturer in China, with strong media partnerships and a diversified client base. It competes with other digital marketing agencies and chemical producers focusing on environmentally friendly products. Its competitive advantages include proprietary AI marketing platforms, extensive media resources, and advanced chemical production capabilities. The company is recognized as a leader in liquid ink technology and a key player in forest chemical deep processing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 8.7 billion RMB, a 9.65% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders dropping by 86.76% to about 13.6 million RMB due to increased credit impairment and goodwill impairment losses. Despite the profit decline, operating cash flow improved significantly. The company has a total asset base of around 2.9 billion RMB and equity attributable to shareholders of about 1.56 billion RMB. It maintains a stable but cautious growth trajectory with ongoing structural adjustments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated digital marketing capabilities empowered by AI and big data, offering clients efficient, innovative, and customized marketing solutions. In chemicals, it differentiates through advanced green technologies, high-quality and stable product performance, and comprehensive service networks. Its proprietary platforms and patented technologies provide competitive advantages in content creation and product innovation. The company also highlights its strong brand reputation, extensive media partnerships, and commitment to sustainable development.
